arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 6000 m, out-and-back 1250 m legs. Calib CP shaft 161 W, Wprime 17.1 kJ; boat CP 109 W. Even-ish target: shaft about CP + Wprime/race time = 161 + 17100/1700 = about 171 W, reserve to empty near finish. Start was hot (254 W shaft at min 1, pod reserve 67 pct). Watch for: rudder weed (push_local drop with steady pod power), current changes, wrong CP (reserve vs feel), wrong distance.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; strongly negative = something new slowing the boat (weed on rudder, current change)

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts: check rudder weed or current change

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.12 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and elapsed_s > 150 and remaining_m > 800
shaft_power_w < 0.9 * sustainable_shaft_power_w and elapsed_s > 150 and remaining_m > 600

arguments.message: 900 m to go: plan the finish

arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into race rhythm, long strokes.

Min 1.2: cued ease (settle). Set derived drag_gap = push_local_mps - push_along_mps and watches: drag_drop (drag_gap < -0.2 for 25 s: weed/current), over_pace (shaft > 1.12x sustainable 45 s), under_pace (shaft < 0.9x sustainable 60 s), finish_zone (remaining < 900 m). No pace targets: current flips each leg, ground-pace target would mislead.

text: Cued ease to settle the hot start (pod reserve 67 pct after 1 min); set watches for over/under pacing, drag drop and the finish.

arguments.text: Ease a touch more. Smooth and steady, long race ahead.

Min 3.4: still 192 W shaft vs sustainable 164, pod reserve 31 pct, boat reserve 30 pct. Cued ease again. Paddler says 7/10 plenty: maybe CP underestimated, or overconfident. Check: if they hold ~190 W for 10 min with no fade while reserve reads near 0, CP is higher (consider set_critical_power). Current pushes about +0.23 on leg 1 (north), expect against on return legs.

text: Cued ease again: 192 W shaft vs 164 sustainable with reserve at 31 pct; paddler feels fine (7/10), noted CP may be low.
